## Verification

## Safety and provenance checklist

- [ ] The change contains no real candidate data, credentials, application answers, or secrets.
- [ ] Generated or external content is treated as untrusted input.
- [ ] Application submission remains human-reviewed by default.
- [ ] New or changed behavior has focused tests.
- [ ] Public documentation and capability status are accurate.
- [ ] No third-party material was copied or adapted, or an approved upstream evaluation is linked.
- [ ] Logs, fixtures, screenshots, and examples are synthetic and privacy-safe.
- [ ] The change is scoped to the linked issue.

## Screenshots or traces

Include privacy-safe evidence only when it materially helps review.
